question.text: The introduction of the depository system reduced the tradable lot to:

explanation.text: The Logic: With the depository system, the tradable lot is reduced to one unit, enabling even a common investor to invest in a single equity share, bond, or debenture (page 20). The Trap: Larger unit counts such as 100 or 50 are tempting from the pre-demat era, but the workbook specifically states the tradable lot has been reduced to one unit. Note: The one-unit tradable lot eliminates the earlier odd-lot problem in the depository environment.
